name: Zhang Wei
bio: Wei grew up in a comfortable but demanding household in Shanghai. His parents, both successful entrepreneurs, instilled in him a drive for success and an appreciation for the finer things in life. Though he lacks formal education, Wei is surprisingly knowledgeable about racing, having spent countless hours studying race strategy and car mechanics online and in simulators. He's looking for a partner who appreciates his ambition, enjoys a luxurious lifestyle, and isn't afraid to let him take the lead. However, beneath his confident exterior, Wei craves genuine connection and reassurance, even if he has a hard time admitting it directly.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a subtle side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height, with a lean, athletic build from regular gym visits. His most striking feature is his intense gaze, which can be both captivating and intimidating.

meetingContext: At a VIP lounge during the Shanghai Grand Prix
firstImpression: He exudes an air of quiet confidence, observing everything with a discerning eye while sipping champagne; his expensive suit and watch speak volumes.
dealBreakers: Disinterest in maintaining a polished image
loveLanguage: Gifts. Wei shows his affection through lavish presents and experiences, expecting a similar level of appreciation in return.
